build_tiled_inference_pipeline: build a tiled inference pipeline on large images using InferenceSlicer with a YOLO callback and 640-pixel slices
run_parallel_slice_inference: run parallel slice inference on large images using InferenceSlicer with ThreadPoolExecutor for concurrent processing
merge_overlapping_detections: merge overlapping detections from tiled inference using InferenceSlicer with NON_MAX_SUPPRESSION overlap filter
move_detection_coordinates: move detection bounding boxes and masks by an offset to reposition them in the full image coordinate system
generate_image_slice_offsets: generate overlapping image slice offsets as bounding boxes for tiled inference on a given image resolution
